items.performers: Kim Kashkashian (viola), Sarah Rothenberg (celesta), Steven Schick (percussion), Lauren Snouffer (soprano), Sonja Bruzauskas (mezzo-soprano), Houston Chamber Choir, Robert Simpson (conductor)
items.recorded: February 2013, The Brown Foundation Performing Arts Theater, Asia Society Texas Center, Houston
items.label: ECM New Series 2378
items.note: Feldman wrote this music for the Houston chapel housing Mark Rothko’s paintings. Kim Kashkashian’s viola sits among celesta, percussion and choir in an album that recreates the programme of the chapel’s fortieth-anniversary concert.

items.recorded: June 2016, Concert Hall, Wyastone Estate, Monmouth
items.label: Hyperion CDA68048
items.note: The piano stays very soft, its damper pedal held down while short phrases recur across seventy-two minutes. Hamelin’s finely controlled touch makes the smallest changes of tone matter.

items.performers: Aki Takahashi (piano); Kronos Quartet: David Harrington, John Sherba (violins), Hank Dutt (viola), Joan Jeanrenaud (cello)
items.recorded: November 1991, Skywalker Sound, Marin County, California
items.label: Nonesuch 79320
items.note: Feldman wrote it in 1985 for Aki Takahashi and the Kronos Quartet, the performers here, and the recording runs 79 minutes. Mark Swed’s liner note: “Chords never appear the same way twice; repetitions of motives are always subtly altered in rhythm.”
